answer: One orchard plot per identity, backed by a sponsor staking 70 credits, lending reputation. Each sponsored identity decays the score, so plot k costs 20+10(k-1). A relic deed ties the plot to one key; reuse or neglect burns the bond and zeroes the score. 1,000 fakes pay 5,015,000 plus 70,000 in bonds for at most 40,000 reward, so the rented-sponsor ring fails. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps the harvest, with the deed as the plot's anchor.
